cause:c1-f6-hose-link-scan-rm-hoselinks-.text: C1-F6 hose-link scan: RM_HoseLinks.Refresh runs once per map per tick (checkedTick), O(reels), so not a bug.

cause:c5-f1-unsaved-flood-driver-inputs-.text: C5-F1 (unsaved flood driver inputs) not changed: marks only seed flow ORDER for a 5000-tick window, no volume lost.

cause:c7a-f8-corridor-hash-rect-bounded-.text: C7a-F8 corridor hash: rect bounded by maxLength<=80 and checked once per 250 ticks per laid reel, so not a bug.

cause:c7b-f6-interrupting-a-wind-removes.text: C7b-F6 (interrupting a wind removes whole trailing cells) is not a bug: inward rounding is the fuzz invariant and nothing is lost.

cause:c7b-f7-carry-trail-growth-grows-on.text: C7b-F7 carry trail growth: grows only while PulledLength<=MaxLength and revisits truncate; ShortenBy runs only while winding, so a 1600-cell serpentine needs deliberate micro; not a bug.

cause:c8b-f2-show-find-assigning-a-surfa.text: C8b-F2: Show/Find assigning a surfaceLook to a lookless fluid on read was not a bug; reading Find shows it never assigns a look on read.

cause:chunk-4-nothing-landed-note-was-st.text: Chunk-4 'nothing landed' note was stale: 77ef94208d had already landed in an earlier run.

cause:defining-own-rm-affordances-was-re.text: Defining own RM_ affordances was rejected: nothing in FlowWorks checks these affordances, donor buildings check their own names, so an RM_ substitute would do nothing.

cause:drain-refuses-unordered-brine-stan.text: Mod paths ruled out as cause: drain refuses unordered brine, StandingOrders is Fill-only, and pour fails on switch. Fault was in the harness, not the mod.

cause:fill-job-goto-never-completes-from.text: The island-restore fill stall was not JobDriver_FillInCanal's GotoCell(A, Touch) failing to finish from the diagonal stand square (172,225). cause:flowworks-rm-patch-liquidheatterra.text: FlowWorks' RM_Patch_LiquidHeatTerrainChanged was not the cause: its postfix was only listed on the Harmony stack of DoTerrainChangedEffects and never ran, because the original threw first. It is a vanilla 1.6 Odyssey bug.

cause:not-a-mod-fault-the-mod-path-stepo.text: Not a mod fault: the mod path StepOne -> next !InBounds -> WashAway -> TakenByLand.Take reads correct; pan=nothing was the expected answer from a 5-11% single pan.

cause:not-the-deep-swim-setting-xw1-gave.text: Not the deep-swim setting: XW1 gave stubs 0, cord_edges 1 with swim on and off, the cell walkable in both; GSS has always drawn a cord there.

cause:p3f-p4f-were-not-a-mod-regression-.text: P3f/P4f were not a mod regression: ProofForcedFlyer launched ThingDefOf.PawnFlyer (no stun), a deliberate jump that lands safely since 0bed9b5796 (pitJumpLandsSafe, RM_Patch_PawnFlyer_LandInPit).

cause:rl4-west-inlet-fail-drawnend-x-76-.text: RL4 west_inlet FAIL (drawnEnd x 76.353 inside its edge) was presumed a stale harness window, not a hose fault: capture showed the coupler on the brass inlet. Marked unproven, then the window fix passed.

cause:s3-was-not-a-classifier-bug-w4-is.text: S3 was not a classifier bug: W4 is a 40-cell EDGE body, and LAKE_GROUNDWATER_REFILL_BUILD_WETNESS_CUT (392300ef0d) makes every edge body limitless however small, so limitless=True is correct.

cause:second-run-the-mod-s-wake-logic-wa.text: Second run: the mod's wake logic was not wrong; both causes were HARNESS (MAX_SAMPLES=80 x SAMPLE_TICKS=3 = 240 ticks too short for pathCost 200 slime / 300 tar; water baseline parsed as None from an empty first snap).

cause:spores-were-not-the-cause-of-the-l.text: Spores were not the cause of the later A1 failure: after the spore purge Vikinger, parked and drafted at 126,126, still ended at 160,95 with Bruise + Crack. Presumed harness (parking not holding a drafted pawn across the sprinkler block), unproven.

cause:stale-row-the-failure-was-not-mere.text: Stale row: the failure was not merely a stale 2026-10-11 result; the re-run on the current build still failed (HARNESS plus a MOD look-table gap).

cause:the-10-18-t6-fail-dehydration-0-07.text: The 10-18 T6 FAIL (dehydration 0.075) was not a mod defect: it traced to the pre-025f7fdbfa harness, which did not draft the pawn, so the pawn drank.

cause:the-12-24-half-full-backup-came-fr.text: The 12/24 half-full backup came from the old test's per-square model; with the game's canal-wide walk the old pour held 22.5/24, so in game the backup was probably never real (offline twin, not live).

cause:the-2026-10-06-save-reload-b-nre.text: The 2026-10-06 save_reload_b NRE in Verse.TickList.BucketOf after load_game_ready was either a null Thing left in a ticklist by a FlowWorks save/load or the runner ticking before load finalized; the record only plans a rerun to split them, so neither is ruled out.

cause:the-7-label-fails-were-not-a-fade.text: The 7 label FAILs were not a fade defect: tops sit exactly at the 1 m line and LabelAlpha=1 by design; the old judge counted share=1 as under.

cause:the-failures-were-not-a-mod-bug-th.text: The failures were not a mod bug: the harness expected a pawn to walk into an uncovered ladderless D=4 pit, which the 2026-10-06 ruling refuses (v2 P3 proves walk-in is refused).

cause:the-fault-was-in-the-harness.text: A Source regression from PIT_TEMPERATURE_SOFTENING_1, PIT_FILL_EFFECTS_1 or PIT_DEPTH_DRAW_OFFSET_1 was ruled out: the fault was in the harness.

cause:the-first-build-made-pipes-join-on.text: The first build made pipes join only on a side or under, never at a corner; the owner ruled this wrong: pipes join whenever adjacent, corners included.

cause:the-first-live-a1-fail-row-lacks-d.text: The first live A1 fail (row lacks dl/fluid at 7cae6d72be18) was not a missing bridge field: the row had dl, and fluid is null on a dry cell (includeTerrain=false) and the bridge JSON omits null members; the proof wrongly read absence as a missing field.

cause:the-hostile-arrival-was-not-on-the.text: The hostile arrival was not on the test map: the GOVERNOR_STOP triggers carried map 3 (Map.uniqueID), a leftover rejected candidate, while the test map was uid 9. It was not map-gen, since the swarm had fresh ids 140275+ at one tick.

cause:the-kernel-does-not-round-the-deci.text: The kernel re-rounding a cell to whole levels each pulse (which would make the law right) was ruled out: the kernel does not round the decilitre away; the check was wrong, not the mod.

cause:the-mod-was-not-wrong-rm-underliqu.text: The mod was not wrong: RM_UnderLiquid.cs:150-154 keeps dry shadow alpha under clear liquid, and RM_SubmergeDraw.cs:450-459 draws it at UnderSheetQueue 2448 < SheetQueue 2449. The 130 FAIL shadows read 0.3 = dry, so the judge was stale.

cause:the-night-live-tank-loop-on-fail-p.text: The night-live tank_loop_on FAIL 'pour-in never ran' was not a mod fault: the harness's new tank was Store mode, and unasked pour only goes into a Fill-mode tank (2026-10-11 rule). The stuff=null log was harness noise, fixed.

cause:the-original-shuttle-was-assumed-t.text: The original shuttle was assumed to reverse or continue: it need not, since with depths [2,2] and water [U,U] the first move leaves [2U,0] and neither cell is eligible again; the pair is not kept between calls and need not be adjacent (Codex finding 3).

cause:the-reopen-notes-for-t13-desperate.text: The reopen notes for T13_desperate_toxic_last (S3da9d64afd, S73995370fc) do not hold: each is a NEW failure signature, not a retired failure returning. Re-derived with the reviewed findings_fold.py.

cause:the-route-planner-entering-wall-ce.text: The route planner entering wall cells (or a stale lay) is not the cause: RouteCells/CordPlanner walk only walkable cells, and a fresh re-lay repeats the fault; the cause was per-cell Clear depth.

cause:the-row-s-own-worker-caused-the-la.text: The row's own worker caused the late bucket: settleJobs showed only Wait_Wander/GotoWander/Wait_MaintainPosture, never a fill or pour job, so it came from another actor.

cause:the-steward-s-claim-that-the-pawn-.text: The steward's claim that the pawn never reached the pits is refuted: cell and depth match on every pad in the call log. The zeros came from one-row pads and the lip clamp. 'Unreached' was true only of the swim and control rows.

cause:the-stub-was-not-a-pipe-centrestub.text: The stub was not a pipe CentreStub/CornerStub/RiserStub or a hose DrawPortStub; it was reel o1's link on the hose layer (HosePortRule.Feed), per census_mapC.json (reel 41679, port RM_UniversalPipe).

cause:the-tap-backs-up-at-half-full-chan.text: The 'tap backs up at half-full channel' problem (12/24) was probably never real in the game: it came from the old test's per-square pour model; with the game's own pour the old rule already held 22.5/24. Measured offline, not in game.

cause:toss-flame-and-liquid-coating-deci.text: toss_flame and liquid coating deciders were not missing features: both already passed on main at fc2ab0af91; the red certificate was old results.

cause:undecided-site-vs-mod-only-by-one-.text: Undecided SITE-vs-MOD only by one live print. - The "weir at the map edge" reading is REFUTED. `FindWeirSite` (`src/RimMandrake/FlowWorks/Source/Rivers/RM_RiverWorksProofWorks.cs:24-69`) already skips a margin of `weirPoolLength + 4` = 12 cells (`RM_RiversSettings.cs:57`, default 8)

cause:visit-1-s-toggle-row-passing-did-n.text: Visit 1's toggle row passing did not show the engine toggled: the old off/on never reached the engine, since EngineSwitch snaps at load unless depthEngineLiveForTests is set.

cause:weir-picked-at-the-map-edge-z-12.text: Weir picked at the map edge (z=12) so no upstream in bounds: refuted, FindWeirSite already skips a margin of weirPoolLength+4 = 12 cells, z=12 is the first allowed row, and earlier runs pooled 14/16/23 cells at that same row. Only the pre-margin run at (79,0,0) read 0 for the edge reason.

version.text: Yes, lock the other four mods (owner, 2026-11-13 ~3:40 PM PST, typed to the Conductor; said of FlowWorks, Gimme Some Slack, Pyrelands, Pyrelands Mechanics)

finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.claim: Absolute rule reads a decked origin at its walking height (RM_PitTrapMath.AbsoluteArrivalDescends); a floor-band origin (under a span deck) reads at its floor in both rules (fresh reader case). b84d6f6337 + d319937af5.
finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.proposed_fix: Evaluate the origin at the deck's walking height instead of raw excavation depth when comparing for IsPitDescent in absolute mode.
finding:ABSOLUTE_DESCENT_FIX_MISSES_DECK.text: With pitRelativeClimbEnabled off, IsFallingArrival (RM_SuperdeepTrap.cs:784-786) compares raw ExcavatedDepthAt of origin and destination. A shove from a deck over the same excavation reads 4->4, so no descent: no fall damage, no spike descent event.

finding:ALL_OFF_FIX_DEPTH_ENGINE_STAYS_O.proposed_fix: Make _setting_in handle depthEngineEnabled the way _setting (extensions.py:334-338) does, enabling depthEngineLiveForTests when switching the engine off.
finding:ALL_OFF_FIX_DEPTH_ENGINE_STAYS_O.text: _setting_in (extensions.py:352-358) writes depthEngineEnabled=False without depthEngineLiveForTests, so the engine stays on (RimMandrakeFlowWorksMod.cs:49 latches until reload). The all_off fixture is not all off and all_off_still_digs can report a false mod failure.

finding:AUTO_SPLICE_FIX_SKIPS_OBSTACLE_C.proposed_fix: Pass a world obstacle predicate and a hose-length limit into the splice solver (MateTail/MatePair) so joins respect walls and reel capacity.
finding:AUTO_SPLICE_FIX_SKIPS_OBSTACLE_C.text: RefreshMates calls MateTail with blocked=null (RM_MapComponent_Hoses.cs:1328-1329; HoseSpliceMath.cs:436), so the splice join between two nearby hose ends can be drawn through walls, and it has no max-length input. Render only.

finding:BIGNET_PROOF_FIX_SIZE_NOT_RESTOR.proposed_fix: Restore size from saved state (st["size"]) in the resumed dig and pulse phases instead of using the command-line default.
finding:BIGNET_PROOF_FIX_SIZE_NOT_RESTOR.text: In flow_bignet_live.py main, only inland is restored from saved state. Resumed dig/pulse phases use the default --size 80 while the result's cells come from st["size"], so the proof can PASS without digging or wetting the intended far corner.

finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.accept: validation_v2 --live --fresh-map shows S5_sticky_limitless PASS (W6 sticky OFF limitless=False).
finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.proposed_fix: not written by its filer: read item:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEVER_FORMS
finding:BODY_CLASSIFY_FIX_STICKY_OFF_NEV.text: In validation_v2 run4, S5_sticky_limitless failed: W6 (stickyLimitless OFF) read limitless=None. flowworks_body_report with classify=true gave classified=false, formedByThisCall=false, indexAgrees=false, isSourceCell=true, no body; twin W7 classified limitless.

finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.accept: Each confirmed finding: a SelfTest/python case that is red on today's code and green with the fix.
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.claim: Fill and wash now debit the body, spent bodies are skipped, and wear is carried across container transitions. Offline selftest GptFixesAChecks (selftest_flowworks_stock.py); no live proof run. (recorded on pre-landing a6ce6a54db; landed as 51bcdabdb8a0)
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.proposed_fix: Debit the body on fill and wash, skip spent bodies, and copy HitPoints across container transitions in MakeContainer.
finding:BOTTLE_STOCK_MEND_FREE_REFILLS.text: Bottle/bucket/barrel fill (JobDriver_FillBottle, RM_LiquidBottleUtility.TryGetLiquidAt reads terrain only) and wash (JobDriver_WashBottle) never debit the body's RM_LiquidStock, so a limited pond creates liquid. MakeContainer builds a fresh Thing without HitPoints, healing containers.

finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.accept: extension_proof.py --live --site dry --chains plot_C_limitless_canal: canal_fill_front PASS (mouth wet, far<=3).
finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.proposed_fix: A cell that received water this pulse cannot donate it on (RM_FlowKernel.creepWaterEnabled, setting waterFrontCreepEnabled, default on), so the front moves 1 cell per pulse from the mouth.
finding:CANAL_FRONT_FIX_WRONG_END_WETS_F.text: A flat dead-end canal channel wets the far end first. The owner wants the wet front to move out from the mouth.

finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.accept: validation_v2 --live on calm: the 5 canal fill rows (E2_channels_fill_every_direction, E3b_recession_shipped, E2s_shared_source_both_fill, E3_budget_exhaustion, E3n_budget_off_supplies) PASS.
finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.proposed_fix: A mouth beside a supplying source never counts as wet, in kernel and oracle.
finding:CANAL_INLET_DIAGNOSE_FIRST_CELL_.text: Since the level solve, source-fed canals wet only their first cell (fill [1,0,0,0]). CellKey kept the wet mouth and levelSet forbids the drop-of-1 swap, so a fed D=1 run stalled: source surface 0 equals mouth surface 0, no feed.

finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.accept: Live: warm map, low-joy colonist beside a shallow poison canal and no other water; read the GoSwimming job target.
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.claim: Patches/Canals/FlowWorks_NoRecreationalSwim.xml marks 44 hazardous fill tiers (oil, poison, blood, chemfuel, astrofuel, boiling water, slimes, tar) with RM_NoRecreationalSwimExtension; plain and icy water stay swimmable. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.proposed_fix: Mark hazardous fill terrains with RM_NoRecreationalSwimExtension, which RM_Patch_JoyGiver_GoSwimming_NoSandSwim vetoes.
finding:CANAL_SWIM_VERIFY_POISON_POOL_PA.text: Poison/oil/fuel canal fills keep the Water tag and have no no-swim marker; JoyGiver_GoSwimming needs only IsWater+Standable, so colonists may swim recreationally in them.

finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.accept: selftest_flowworks_fuel_moat.py case chemfuel_registry_names_canal_fluid red on the old registry, green with the fix.
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.claim: Chemfuel and astrofuel canal fluids wired (b0ec1721ff); also chemfuel inferno and astrofuel chained detonation (1a5a2ceee7) and the Utinni raid and Visibility rise (6238e06206). Offline green only. (recorded on pre-landing 6e4fc00401; landed as 35743b48eed2)
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.proposed_fix: Wire canalFluid onto the chemfuel/astrofuel rows (propane split to PROPANE_CANAL_WIRE_STILL_NO_FLUID).
finding:CHEMFUEL_MOAT_WIRE_MISSING_CHANN.text: RM_Liquid_Chemfuel (RM_LiquidDefRegistry.xml:458) and propane rows carry no canalFluid, though RM_Fluid_Chemfuel/Astrofuel exist (FlowWorks_PitFluids.xml:67,84). Fuel cannot be pumped into a moat; a liquid with no channel form spills (RM_LiquidSpill).

finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.accept: A1: selftest Concealed_cover_does_not_shield_the_pawn_beneath_it_from_the_fill passes. A2: a pawn beneath a concealed lid in a toxic or deep-filled pit gains toxic buildup or drowns as an uncovered pawn would.
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.claim: Fixed in source (e3b0a513a649 (pre-landing; landed as 8c8bd865f358)): a pawn beneath a concealed cover no longer gets zero splash share. Selftest red-then-green; live check owed.
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.proposed_fix: Make the concealed-cover case count in UnderDeck/SplashShare so a pawn beneath a lid is poisoned and drowned like an uncovered pawn.
finding:CONCEALED_COVER_FIX_SHIELDS_FROM.text: UnderDeck recognizes only InFloorBand pawns (RM_SuspensionPatches.cs:313-316), so a pawn beneath a solid concealed cover (IsBeneath) gets SplashShare 0. RM_PitFillEffects.Tick then skips poisoning and drowning, leaving it immune to toxic/fill around it.

finding:COVER_BLAST_FIX_DECK_LEFT_INTACT.proposed_fix: Spring the connected deck when a cover is killed by the blast, in DeSpawn or the RM_Patch_ExplosionBreaksPitCover postfix.
finding:COVER_BLAST_FIX_DECK_LEFT_INTACT.text: A blast that kills a cover before the explosion postfix runs drops only that cover's riders in DeSpawn (Building_PitCover.cs:146-182). The postfix then finds no cover and returns, so the connected deck beyond the radius is not sprung.

finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.accept: Each confirmed finding: a SelfTest/python case red on today's code and green with the fix.
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.claim: A cover with a lower-id cardinal neighbour returns before flooding (C4-F3); a mixed deck springs at its weakest cover's rating (C4-F5); the 400 cap on Deck() is removed (C4-F6). The inspect line still shows each cover's own rating. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.proposed_fix: Return early for covers with a lower-id cardinal neighbour so only local minima flood; spring a mixed deck at its weakest cover's rating; remove the 400 cap on Deck().
finding:COVER_DECK_TUNE_QUADRATIC_CENSUS.text: Every pit cover floods its whole deck each scan (O(N^2) on big covered moats; CompPitCoverTrigger.cs:73-76 builds Deck before the lead check). A mixed-tier deck springs at the lowest-id lead's tier, and decks over 400 covers are truncated (Building_PitCover.cs:65), giving several leads and partial collapse.

finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.accept: Each confirmed finding: a SelfTest/python case red on today's code and green with the fix.
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.claim: dbh_water now sits only on plain waters (generator + 15 terrain files); full DBH is gated in (strings verified in its 1.6 DLL). F5 (bucket value 5 versus capacityFactor 1.2/0.8) is not fixable in XML since WaterExt is per ThingDef. (recorded on pre-landing 80ac4bda4b; landed as 579306aad895)
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.proposed_fix: Tag dbh_water only on plain waters (generator and terrain files) and gate full DBH in alongside Lite; the bucket value is not fixable in XML.
finding:DBH_WATER_MEND_ACID_ON_TAP.text: 19 hazardous liquid terrains (acid, propane, tar, slime, poisoned water) inherit the dbh_water tag, so with DBH they become wash/drink sources. DBH integration also fires only for 'Dubs Bad Hygiene Lite', not full DBH, and a bucket's DBH water value is fixed at 5.

finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.accept: deploy DLL dbc55e224cd8 or later, run deep_lake_proof.py <out> --fresh-map; DL_lake_over_4000_is_limited passes, and DL_drained_reads_gradual_hollow PASS (deepestDry > 4, lakebedAbyss > 0) with both colonist rows measured.
finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.proposed_fix: Harness fix: the form reports the generator's draw, a draw at the notch retries the next origin, and the MOD row judges record == draw. No mod change.
finding:DEEP_BEDS_FIX_FLOOR_STOPS_AT_FOU.text: The painted 5184-square lake read deepest=4 and bedSum=19080 with deepBedsEnabled, lakeDepthScale=2, deepBedMaxDepth=20, failing DL_lake_over_4000_is_limited and DL_drained_reads_gradual_hollow; the belt run read deepest=12. Deep beds are laid only when !AnyMovingWater (RM_LiquidStock.cs:236).

finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.accept: Live: a thirsty pawn beside deep sand does not drink it (A1, L1). Sand-as-pond-source C# check not filed.
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.claim: Fixed the drink half only (bd36286c4795 (pre-landing; landed as 015b7892e833)): a thirsty pawn no longer drinks deep sand. The IsNaturalLiquid pond-source half was not fixed.
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.proposed_fix: Exclude RM_DeepSand from freshwater drinking identity and from RM_MapComponent_Excavation.IsNaturalLiquid as a pond source, so the fishing tag no longer makes it a reservoir.
finding:DEEP_SAND_FIX_READS_AS_FRESHWATE.text: RM_DeepSand carries a Freshwater body and a Water tag (for fishing). RM_ThirstUtility.cs:138 (IsWater && !IsOcean) makes it drinkable, and RM_MapComponent_Excavation accepts any undug Water-tagged terrain as a pond source.

finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.accept: deep_stone_live.py --fresh-map logs a job_probe hasJobOnCell RM_DigCanalJob plus an accepted order, depth 3->4, and scores DS_superdeep_cut.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.claim: Added a job probe plus ordered_job (1edfffa47149 (pre-landing; landed as b61e5f66b486)). The order is accepted but the cut is still unmeasured: depth stayed 3->3 in 6000 ticks on the s5 rerun.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.proposed_fix: Force a colonist onto the job (jawa/prioritized_work or ordered_job on the designation) instead of waiting on the AI scan, and read the job taken before the clock starts.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_NOBODY_PICKS_UP_S.text: deep_stone_live.py --fresh-map leaves DS_superdeep_cut_turns_up_deep_stone UNMEASURED: no colonist takes the RM_DigCanal designation in 6000 ticks (depth stays 3, DIGFINDS 0), because the row waits on the AI scan.

finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.claim: The probe call now passes pawnId= and a selftest scans kwargs against tool_schemas (14a3d414018f (pre-landing; landed as b06770af5568)). The live rerun's job_probe reply carries the workGiver and pawn blocks and the order is accepted, but depth stayed 3, so A1 is not verified.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.proposed_fix: Pass pawnId=, and add a selftest that the probe kwargs match the tool signature. Then rerun --fresh-map.
finding:DEEP_STONE_FIX_PROBE_NEVER_NAMES.text: deep_stone_live.py:149 calls flowworks_job_probe with pawn= but the tool's parameter is pawnId= (JawaBenchFlowWorksJobProbeTools.cs:67). The pawn is dropped, the WorkGiver half never runs, and the job gate rejects a run whose order was taken.

finding:DEEP_STONE_PROOF_FIX_RERUN_LETTE.proposed_fix: Not stated in the record beyond the finding. Make the verdict stop requiring a new first-find letter on a rerun (or clear the discovery set).
finding:DEEP_STONE_PROOF_FIX_RERUN_LETTE.text: deep_stone_live.py:176-177 requires a new 'Deep stone' first-find letter, but RM_DigDiscovery.cs:161 found.Add fires once per def per map. A correct rerun without --fresh-map reports MOD FAIL.

finding:DEPTH_PROOFS_FIX_EXIT_ZERO_ON_FA.proposed_fix: Make main return nonzero when any row FAILs.
finding:DEPTH_PROOFS_FIX_EXIT_ZERO_ON_FA.text: depth_rebuild_proofs.py:526 main returns 0 regardless of FAIL rows (only line 163 returns 2). A gate reading the exit status sees success after failed proofs, e.g. --only p5 with a wrong liquid total.

finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.accept: modcheck FlowWorks dig_finds via testq lane steve-targeted on SteveDesktop: finds_off_none, cut_turns_up_local_find, first_find_sends_letter must each PASS; standalone quarry_find_live.py row QUARRY_FIND_DROPS_ON_LIP.
finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.proposed_fix: Not filed. Leading hypothesis suggests lowering labour or lengthening the wait windows, as with droid_dig_live (LABOUR = 0.25, WAIT_TICKS = 15000).
finding:DIG_FINDS_PROVE_NEVER_FINISHES_O.text: The dig_finds chain on SteveDesktop fails 'the dig job never finished' (29 fails since 2026-10-26). Hypothesis: digLabourMultiplier x4 makes cuts 7,529/15,059/22,588 ticks, beyond the 8,000-tick window; quarry_find_live waits 4,000.

finding:DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_MOAT_WITH_MANNE.accept: drawbridge_proof.py --fresh-map 12/12 PASS on all R13 rows (verified 2026-10-22 on 41fb948b5e), plus SelfTest DrawbridgeChecks; the owner's in-game look (A3) is owed.
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_BUILD_MOAT_WITH_MANNE.text: Task: build the ruled FlowWorks drawbridge (timber hand-winch, steel powered) with bascule leaf, gate leaf and planks as art; riders tip to the hinge bank, auto-lower for friendlies, lock on free hostiles, with raider support and a forced pocket-grid rebuild on toggle.

finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.accept: none, no acceptance test filed; item only records the defect
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.proposed_fix: On lowering, classify occupants beneath the restored deck as floor-band, as Notify_DeckBuilt does for newly built decks; SweepUnder (RM_MapComponent_SuspensionBridges.cs:916-939) clears the flags while raised.
finding:DRAWBRIDGE_LOWER_FIX_LIFTS_OCCUP.text: Lowering a drawbridge leaf restores StructuralDeckAt cells (Apply, RM_Drawbridges.cs:305-334) without classifying pawns already on the floor beneath into the floor band, so they read as on the deck: draw height, load, immersion protection and movement band change.

finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.accept: A new player can read the changed UI and know what to do next; old confusing text gone (grep); FlowWorks selftests stay as green as before.
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.claim: The drill/tap PlaceWorker now draws the survey beside the mouse while placing ('Subsurface: <liquid>, <litres> remaining', or red 'nothing drillable under this map / reserve used up'), plus a red line when drilling is off. Drill description updated. Placement not refused. (recorded on pre-landing 4e090d7ba1
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.proposed_fix: Show the survey while placing (PlaceWorker readout/ghost text) or on the map's info.
finding:DRILL_SURVEY_EXPLAIN_BEFORE_STEE.text: The subsurface survey ('nothing drillable found under this map') was readable only on a built drill (Building_LiquidDrill.GetInspectString), so a player spent steel, components and 400 W to learn nothing was there.

finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.accept: none, no acceptance test filed; item only records the defect
finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.proposed_fix: Make ExitInReach read StepDepthAt at the pawn's floor-band height, not the deck's surface height, for pawns beneath a deck.
finding:DROWNING_ESCAPE_FIX_READS_DECK_A.text: RM_Drowning.ExitInReach reads StepDepthAt of the decked square at deck height (RM_PitFillEffects.cs:220-238), so a floor-band pawn under a bridge beside an undug bank is judged able to step out and gets no drowning severity.

finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.accept: A1: a save with dug channels all filled back reloads with no cells re-read as excavations; A2: filling a channel with no recorded original terrain hands back surrounding ground, not channel terrain.
finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.proposed_fix: Add a saved migration flag plus a fallback terrain for unrecorded cells.
finding:EXCAVATION_LEGACY_MIGRATION_FLAG.text: RehydrateFromTerrainIfEmpty runs whenever the depth grid is all zero and records no original terrain; FillIn's Surface branch then cannot restore, leaving channel terrain at D=0 that the next load re-reads as an excavation.

finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.accept: Each confirmed finding: a SelfTest/python case (or live state read) red on old code, green with fix. Live: pair a ferry with river empty, read RopeIndicesNoRebuild.Count and an undrafted path before any RopeCellCount read.
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.claim: C6-F1 fixed: MapComponentTick rebuilds dirty works (rope/pool cells) at once, so undrafted routing sees a ferry after load or pairing. C6-F8 (same-bank pairing) not fixed. (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.proposed_fix: Rebuild dirty works at once so routing sees the ferry; same-bank pairing needs an opposite-bank test.
finding:FERRY_ROPE_FIX_BUILT_ONLY_WHEN_A.text: Ferry rope cells are derived and built only when something reads them (EnsureWorks via InPool/OnRope/RopeCellCount), so undrafted routing (ApplyRope reads RopeIndicesNoRebuild) can ignore a valid ferry after load or pairing. Posts also pair with the nearest unpaired post even on the same bank.

finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.accept: Live: a thirsty pawn beside a chemfuel, oil or poison canal fill does not drink it.
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.claim: 24 hazard fill terrains switched to the inert RM_Liquid_NotDrinkable; selftest green. (recorded on pre-landing bd36286c4795; landed as 015b7892e833)
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.proposed_fix: Give hazard fill terrains a non-drinkable identity instead of the Water tags.
finding:FILL_TERRAIN_FIX_HAZARDS_DRUNK_A.text: Chemfuel and other hazard canal fill terrains carry Water/WaterFreshShallow tags and no terrainSuite registers them, so RM_ThirstUtility falls back to fresh water and pawns drink them as potable, with the canal quantity unchanged.

finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.accept: PrePortFixChecks P8 (old-path can-fail): burn pulse consumes a canal level only when the cell liquid burns now.
finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.proposed_fix: Consume a canal level only when the cell liquid burns now, and keep the fire check interval below the pulse floor.
finding:FIRE_BURN_PULSE_PROVE_REFILL_RAC.text: The liquid-fire burn pulse (RM_LiquidFire.cs ~428-450) may consume replacement water that refilled the cell; path unverified.

finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.accept: PrePortFixChecks P5 (old-rule can-fail 36 vs 9); live: a release into a dug D4 channel spends 4 x volumePerTile per cell on the debug report.
finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.proposed_fix: Debit volumePerTile per level added and fill only payable levels.
finding:FLOOD_DEBIT_MEND_DEEP_CELL_ONE_L.text: A flood fills a D4 cell for only one volumePerTile (Flood_FlowWorks.cs ~333-343 vs RM_MapComponent_Excavation.cs ~1256-1261) instead of debiting the full depth filled.

finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.accept: A1 (L2): a release into a dry dug channel leaves engine fill (FillAt>0), no flood temp terrain, nothing strips it at recede.
finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.proposed_fix: Route legacy releases on excavated cells through the driver API and return an outcome enum.
finding:FLOOD_DRIVER_OWNERSHIP_CONTRACT_.text: FluidDef.OwnsFillTerrain includes floodTerrain, so ApplyFillTerrain/ClearFillTerrain strip a legacy Flood_FlowWorks placement on an excavated cell and legacy QueueRemoveTerrain can strip an engine fill. TrySetDriverFill returns false both for 'not mine' and for refused cells, so drivers fall back to terrain writes.

finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.accept: Offline/live: release beside a 1-level water inlet vs a dry inlet, compare reach; offline round-trip of a release with a refused cell.
finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.claim: C5-F11 fixed: CanFloodInto no longer refuses a wet DUG cell before the engine decides (ViaEngine/HandsOff). (recorded on pre-landing 0377b63928; landed as 17a082d2d09a)
finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.proposed_fix: Drop the IsWater refusal so the engine decides (ViaEngine/HandsOff).
finding:FLOOD_RELEASE_PROBE_FORGOTTEN_RE.text: Flood driver inputs are not saved, a flood's refusals are forgotten on reload, and CanFloodInto (Flood_FlowWorks.cs:290-294) rejected partly filled (IsWater) channel cells and anything beyond a wet inlet.

finding:FLOOD_SWITCH_RACE_MEND_ENGINE_OF.accept: PrePortFixChecks P6a (old-guard can-fail); live: switch off, release into a dug channel leaves terrain and fill unchanged past the recede tick.
finding:FLOOD_SWITCH_RACE_MEND_ENGINE_OF.proposed_fix: With the switch off, a flood release keeps hands off excavated cells and puts no temp terrain on engine cells.
finding:FLOOD_SWITCH_RACE_MEND_ENGINE_OF.text: With legacyFloodViaEngineEnabled off, a flood release restores the old flood/terrain race on excavated cells (Flood_FlowWorks.cs ~333, 353-354).

finding:FLOWPINS_FIX_PASS_ON_REGRESSION.accept: Each fixed pin red on mutant and green on source.
finding:FLOWPINS_FIX_PASS_ON_REGRESSION.claim: 4 pins fixed, each red on mutant and green on source: Pit settings list, god-mode return, RevisionKey theft bit, DugSwim collection alloc. (recorded on pre-landing 719344e6fd22; landed as da5c09f66fe0)
finding:FLOWPINS_FIX_PASS_ON_REGRESSION.proposed_fix: Tighten each confirmed pin so it goes red on a mutant and green on source.
finding:FLOWPINS_FIX_PASS_ON_REGRESSION.text: FlowWorks SelfTest source pins pass on the regression they claim to catch; e.g. PitAccessChecks:144 summed two overlapping regexes so losing the ResolveArrivalNow detector still counted 2, and 'in the settings section list' is satisfied by the Scribe key string itself.

finding:FLOWWORKSMOD_DOC_FIX_STALE_PHASE.accept: none, comment-only change; code verified fine

finding:LIQUID_FIRE_MEND_COVER_AND_SAVE.accept: Each CONFIRMED finding: a SelfTest/python case that goes red on old code, then green with the fix.
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_MEND_COVER_AND_SAVE.claim: Carried and burning fluids are now saved, flyers and cover are respected by liquid fire effects, and blast hops are keyed by Explosion id instead of centre cell. (recorded on pre-landing 9bca729c18; landed as 86c093c8c5d1)
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_MEND_COVER_AND_SAVE.proposed_fix: Save carried/burning fluid in ExposeData; make ApplyEffects respect an intact cover and flyers; key blast hops by Explosion id rather than centre cell.
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_MEND_COVER_AND_SAVE.text: RM_LiquidFire does not save carriedAcc/carriedTick/carriedFluid/burningFluid, so after load TakeCarried treats a null fluid as matching any. ApplyEffects ignores cover and Flying, and blastHops is keyed by centre cell only, so a later explosion inherits the 300-tick hop limit.

finding:LIQUID_FIRE_QUEUE_ORIGIN_1.accept: A1: a chemfuel canal detonating into its source pond lights no pond cell beyond sourceFireReach; A2: a torch beside a pending tar cell lights it within one check; A3: a pending front survives save/reload.
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_QUEUE_ORIGIN_1.claim: Closed with A1-A3 rows passing live: blast origin/hops carried, offers can advance pending cells, carried burn scoped (provisional 600-tick expiry, 300-tick front-blast memory). (recorded on pre-landing e3f885330d; landed as de853778c885)
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_QUEUE_ORIGIN_1.proposed_fix: Carry origin/hops through blasts; use a keyed pending map so earlier offers can advance a pending cell; scope carried burn progress by fluid and expiry.
finding:LIQUID_FIRE_QUEUE_ORIGIN_1.text: NotifyExplosionAt queues every blast cell at hops 0, so a detonation re-seeds zero-hop ignition deeper into a body and SourceFireReach stops binding. TryQueue drops offers for already-pending cells, so a torch cannot advance a slow fuse. carriedAcc has no expiry or fluid identity.

finding:LIQUID_KIT_COMMENTS_CORRECT_GHOS.claim: Comments now say neither patch exists and which item owes the wiring. (recorded on pre-landing 7516d45c9571; landed as 33e7e4c3ee8a)

finding:LIQUID_LOOK_MATERIAL_OWNERSHIP_1.proposed_fix: Census FluidDefs for key collisions, then give each look owned materials, destroyed on revert.

finding:LIQUID_RECESSION_TOPOLOGY_1.text: RM_LiquidStock.PickRecedeCell counts owner.IsSourceCell(n), which is any natural liquid, and lowest degree is not an articulation test, so 'never fragments' is unenforced. finding:LIQUID_ROTATION_FIX_STARVED_STRA.accept: Each CONFIRMED finding: a SelfTest/python case that goes red on old code, then green with the fix.
finding:LIQUID_ROTATION_FIX_STARVED_STRA.claim: Rotation is keyed per store with forfeit after one yield (fixing the map-wide stall), and multi-input converters use NextRunnable (fixing first-liquid-only). (recorded on pre-landing 69a9a10adb; landed as 7e492a762f01)
finding:LIQUID_ROTATION_FIX_STARVED_STRA.proposed_fix: Key rotation per store with a forfeit after one yield; replace FirstRunnable with NextRunnable so multi-input rotates per cycle.
finding:LIQUID_ROTATION_FIX_STARVED_STRA.text: MayDraw (RM_LiquidNetKernel.cs:447) keys consumer rotation by LiquidDef only, so an isolated starved machine re-starves each cycle and a supplied machine is never served. finding:LIQUID_THEFT_FIX_TANK_HIDES_ITSE.accept: Selftest Theft_witness_sees_a_2x2_tank_from_every_side passes; live fw_live_checks L6_theft_spotted_letter PASS (caught 0 -> 1 with NE witnesses), then rimflow verify --criterion A2.
finding:LIQUID_THEFT_FIX_TANK_HIDES_ITSE.proposed_fix: Call GenSight.LineOfSight(p.Position, tank.Position, map, CellRect.SingleCell(p.Position), tank.OccupiedRect()) (the rect overload); add a selftest/live row with a witness on each side of a 2x2 tank.
finding:LIQUID_THEFT_FIX_TANK_HIDES_ITSE.text: RM_LiquidTheft.Witness uses the 3-arg GenSight.LineOfSight ending at tank.Position; the 2x2 RM_LiquidTank (fillPercent 1.0) blocks sight through its other three cells, so a witness whose line enters elsewhere never sees it and caught stays 0.

finding:LIQUID_THEFT_VERIFY_FALSE_ACCUSA.accept: Offline selftest GptFixesAChecks (selftest_flowworks_stock.py) red on old code, green with fix; live check owed: foreign tank, no player link, static_call stock change, caught/charges stay 0.

finding:LIQUID_THEFT_VERIFY_FALSE_ACCUSA.text: RM_LiquidTheft.TheftTick compares stock snapshots only, so any change on a foreign tank (corrosion, heat, its owners' machines) charges goodwill as player theft; a balanced take+put between cycles escapes.

finding:NATURAL_HEAT_CACHE_PROVE_STALE_D.text: The natural-heat cache trusts terrain for 15,000 ticks after it changes, so a terrain change (e.g. draining a hot pool) is not seen until the cache expires.

finding:NATURAL_LIQUID_FIX_PUMPS_AS_FRES.proposed_fix: Give such liquids their own FluidDefs/canal forms (and fill ladders), or add a C# refuse-to-pump rule.

finding:OUTFLOW_REGRESSION_FIX_HARDCODED.text: fw_pond_outflow_regression.py hardcodes CAP=30, but capacity is bed levels x volumePerTile (shallow = 2 notches), so `drained` is inflated and an undrained pond can pass; channel fills are never asserted.

finding:P5_SITE_FIX_RERUN_DIGS_DEEPER.accept: Running P5 twice on one map gives the same depth.
finding:P5_SITE_FIX_RERUN_DIGS_DEEPER.proposed_fix: Reset excavation on the P5 site before dig() (as climb_proof.py does, which resets and checks its old digs).
finding:P5_SITE_FIX_RERUN_DIGS_DEEPER.text: depth_rebuild_proofs prepare_site repaints terrain but does not reset excavation; dig() adds deepenLevels to the existing cut, so a second --only p5 run on the same map measures deeper geometry and can falsely fail the 152,000 L expectation.

finding:PIPE_ADAPTER_FIX_DEBT_NEVER_PAID.text: Adapter Send mode with a partial foreign accept: SettleSend refunds the whole unit and records -fraction in carry, but the Send path never consults negative carry (only Take does), so liquid is created.

finding:PIT_PRISON_JUDGE_D3_ROOMS.text: A sheer D3 person-band pocket formed a pit prison room (RM_PitRooms.IsPitCell uses the person pocket) while capture-down and lip service need IsSuperdeepExcavation (D4).

finding:PIT_RAIN_FIX_FRACTIONAL_HEADROOM.proposed_fix: Fix RoomNotches/ApplyRain so fractional headroom is filled before overflow (not stated more precisely).
finding:PIT_RAIN_FIX_FRACTIONAL_HEADROOM.text: Rain uses whole-notch RoomNotches; a part-filled cell with under one notch of headroom returns 0, so all rain goes to surface overflow instead of filling the excavation, and contributes nothing if sheet overflow is disabled or refused.

finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.accept: Selftest PitRamp_walked_step_down_a_ramp_is_no_fall passes; live: a raider walking down a 3-notch pit ramp takes no fall damage and no fall message.
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.claim: Fixed in source (e3b0a513a649 (pre-landing; landed as 8c8bd865f358)) so a walked step down a ramp is no fall; selftest red-then-green.
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.proposed_fix: Exempt a walked step down a ramp from the fall classification.
finding:PIT_RAMP_FIX_WALKER_TAKES_FALL.text: IsFallingArrival judges by NaturalClimbLimitOf with no ramp exemption, and DescentFalls exempts only ladders/gear, so a captured hostile walking down a valid 3-notch ramp takes fall damage.

finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.claim: StartPath now records its walker and the veto answers for it (C3-F4); masks and step floor step aside for a pawn too wide for its pocket (C3-F5). (recorded on pre-landing 009abe3c49; landed as 9b22587f388a)
finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.proposed_fix: Have StartPath record its walker so the veto answers for it; make masks and step floor step aside for a pawn too wide for its pocket.
finding:PIT_REACH_VERIFY_FLYERS_AND_GIAN.text: Vanilla StartPath runs a pawnless CanReach, so RelativeVeto used the person band with no flyer exemption (flyers and K3+ pawns refused valid routes); and cliff masks still walled in a pawn too wide for its hole.

finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.accept: Run validation_v2 phase P, reload an earlier tick, run again: the held friendly re-plans; no red error naming RM_SuperdeepTrap / RM_Patch_PathFollower_SuperdeepFloor in Player.log.
finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.proposed_fix: Fix the static per-game state (cooldown and trap-region cache) so it does not outlive a reload or ignore the map.
finding:PIT_REROUTE_FIX_TIME_TRAVEL_FORG.text: The pit reroute cooldown survives a reload, so an earlier save refused re-plans; the trap-region cache ignores the map.

finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.accept: Selftest PitRescue_only_a_colonist_assigned_Doctor_counts_as_a_rescuer passes; live, a downed pawn whose only reachable colonist has Doctor unticked still gets the rescue ladder.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.claim: Batch C source fix so only a colonist assigned Doctor counts as a rescuer; selftest went red then green. Live check still owed. (recorded on pre-landing e3b0a513a649; landed as 8c8bd865f358)
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.proposed_fix: Count only colonists vanilla DoctorRescue would send, i.e. those assigned Doctor work, as available rescuers in AnyRescuerReaches, per its own doc at lines 155-159.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_COUNTS_DOCTOR_OFF.text: AnyRescuerReaches (RM_PitAccess.cs:165-167) uses WorkTypeIsDisabled, which tests capability, not the Work-tab setting. A colonist with Doctor unticked counts as a rescuer and suppresses the rescue ladder indefinitely though they never take the rescue job.

finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_UNREACHABLE_SPARE.proposed_fix: Add a reachability check to SparePortable so an unreachable minified ladder is not chosen over building a new one.
finding:PIT_RESCUE_FIX_UNREACHABLE_SPARE.text: SparePortable (RM_PitAccess.cs:257-268) picks a minified portable ladder without checking reachability. For one in a sealed chamber, TryQueueFor makes an install blueprint nobody can finish, and the pending blueprint stops later attempts building a ladder, so rescue stalls.

finding:PIT_SHOT_PROOF_FIX_OTHER_TARGET_.proposed_fix: Make the P7 row prove eb itself is unhittable or refused, not merely that a different target was picked.
finding:PIT_SHOT_PROOF_FIX_OTHER_TARGET_.text: Row P7_shoot_between_7m_pits_refused (depth_rebuild_proofs.py:418-421) passes whenever the picked target differs from eb. If eb became a legal target but the AI chose another hostile (e.g. the trench-control target), the row still passes.

finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.accept: In-game FlowWorks selftest PitTravel_every_trap_mask_reach_and_fall_read_asks_it passes with the one-pattern count (>=2) on the shipped RM_SuperdeepTrap.
finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.proposed_fix: Replace the two summed patterns with one \s* pattern counted once, so a dropped detector reads 1 < 2.
finding:PIT_TRAVEL_SELFTEST_FIX_DOUBLE_C.text: Selftest PitTravel_every_trap_mask_reach_and_fall_read_asks_it summed two regexes; Src collapses whitespace so both matched both detectors (4 matches). Removing the free-traveller guard from one detector still gave >=2 and passed.

finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.accept: Each CONFIRMED finding: a SelfTest/python case that goes red on today's code, then green with the fix.
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.claim: RM_LiquidBottleUtility.PlacePaidFor (Near, else spawn on the cell; revert-in-container drops to ground) fixed reaction/fill/revert; dig find charges the merged share; weir Deposit returns what merged. (recorded on pre-landing 8fdc692b89; landed as b7b7c3b3df58)
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.proposed_fix: Route placements through a paid-for placement helper that falls back when placement fails, and charge or return what actually merged for dig finds and weir catches.
finding:PLACEMENT_FAILURE_MEND_LOST_IN_P.text: TryPlaceThing failures after a debit lose goods: reaction products (RM_LiquidReaction.Drop ignores the result), fill-from-tank and revert, dig finds merged partly into a stack (not charged to budget), weir catch (Deposit returns 0 after a partial merge, so fish stock is not debited).

finding:PLACER_SELFCHECK_FIX_LEAVES_MERG.proposed_fix: Make selfcheck cleanup also remove ore that merged into existing stacks, not only newly created Things.
finding:PLACER_SELFCHECK_FIX_LEAVES_MERG.text: RM_PlacerProof.SelfCheck cleanup (RM_PlacerWorks.cs:708-746) tracks only newly created Thing ids. Ore merged into a pre-existing stack survives, so repeated checks change colony resources and contaminate later live-state measurements.

finding:POCKET_TRAP_FIX_LADDER_TO_SEALED.proposed_fix: Have TrappedIn follow the ladder graph and check that it reaches an escapable component, not just one hop across the component boundary.
finding:POCKET_TRAP_FIX_LADDER_TO_SEALED.text: RM_PocketGrid.TrappedIn (RM_PocketGrid.cs:822) passes a one-hop UsableLadderIn to Trapped, so a ladder onto a shelf that is itself enclosed reads as escape. The upright stranded pawn is not trapped, so TryQueueFor gives no rescue.

finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.accept: TransferChecks Transfer_site_pump_draw_pond_to_the_last_decilitre passes; live, a pump beside a pond under 1,000 L draws stockDl to 0 and the tank gains exactly that.
finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.proposed_fix: With exact-level on, let a pump draw a natural pond down to 0 dL, and stage its last squares to mud/bed once dry.
finding:POND_PUMP_FIX_LAST_DROP_COUNTS.text: A natural pond did not pump to its last decilitre like a dug channel; a sub-notch remainder stayed.

finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.accept: Live northstar/live_probes/fw_pond_outflow_regression.py PASS on a fresh site; FlowWorks selftest incl. Recession_order_spares_an_OUTFLOW_cell_until_last.
finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.proposed_fix: Recession should keep cells with live outflow, or treat the pond as one level, so a channel or pump drains the pond.
finding:POND_RECESSION_STRANDS_CHANNEL_1.text: A limited pond recedes the very cell its channel draws from, stranding about 80% of stock: a 6-cell pond with an 8-cell channel drains 6 of 30 and then stops every time.

finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.accept: Production RM_DriverInputs + kernel: after reload a brimming pump outlet re-marks and the dug-on channel fills (selftest_flowworks_stock.py); live, a pump against a saved brimming outlet, reloaded and dug on, spreads into the extension.
finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.proposed_fix: Write the brimming-outlet reload test first; fix only if it fails.
finding:PUMP_FED_CHANNEL_STALL_PROVE_AFT.text: A pump-fed channel may stall after reload because driverInputTick is unsaved (RM_MapComponent_Excavation.cs ~1483-1485, 1196-1200). Write the brimming-outlet reload test first and fix only if it fails.

finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.accept: Live fw_live_checks L2_pump_pour_drains_dump_fast PASS with DLL e8860a76 (L2b drainedPer1000 > L2a); selftest Pump_pour_is_faster_than_gravity.
finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.proposed_fix: Pour cycle budget = RM_PumpMath.PourLevels(levelsPerCycle, dumpUnitsPerCycle) = max(levelsPerCycle, dumpUnitsPerCycle/5+1), always above the gravity rate.
finding:PUMP_POUR_TUNE_NO_FASTER_THAN_GR.text: Basic RM_LiquidPump on Pour drains a Dump tank no faster than gravity: levelsPerCycle defaults to 1 (5 units/250-tick cycle), equal to dumpUnitsPerCycle (5). Live 20 vs 25 units per 1000 ticks, against ruling Q3 that pour is the fast drain.

finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.accept: raid_trench_proof.py RAID_SHALLOW_FILLED_IN_RAID / RAID_DEEP_NOT_FILLED / RAID_NO_MELEE_GOES_AROUND; RaiderTrenchChecks 6/6 offline; A2-A7 live rows.
finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.proposed_fix: Append JobGiver_RM_CrossTrench to AssaultColony (after AIBreaching/AISapper). Order: jump, scaling ladders, then melee-only fill causeway for pits at or under the 4 (2 m) fill line; deeper: shoot, cast position or leave. Sieges excluded.
finding:RAIDERS_TRENCH_BUILD_BREACH_AND_.text: Raiders facing a trench with no reachable colonist/building target would stall at the lip; vanilla AssaultColony has no cross-trench job. Surface-to-surface across a trench is never one reachability hop (RelativeVeto), so after ladders stand the raider is sent into the trench and vanilla takes over.

finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.accept: Selftest Drawbridge_raid_plank_between_sunken_banks_lies_at_their_depth passes; live: plank between two 4-notch banks reads deck at ledge depth and pawns cross.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.claim: Fixed in source (e3b0a513a649 (pre-landing; landed as 8c8bd865f358)): raid plank between sunken banks now lies at their depth; selftest went red then green. Live check still owed.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.proposed_fix: Set deckNotches on the raid plank record in RM_RaidPlanks.TryLay (RM_DrawbridgeRaid.cs:295-303) to the banks' depth.
finding:RAID_PLANK_FIX_SURFACE_HEIGHT_SU.text: RaidPlankFits accepts equal banks at any depth but RM_RaidPlanks.TryLay never sets deckNotches (stays 0), so a plank between sunken banks registers at surface height, giving wrong access, draw height, underpass class and fall distance.

finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.claim: ReachVetoed needs a way at both ends (C3-F8/C4-F2); map-edge veto cuts off a surface island (C3-F9); absolute-rule BFS stops at walls (C3-F12). (recorded on pre-landing 009abe3c49; landed as 9b22587f388a)
finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.proposed_fix: Require a way at both ends in ReachVetoed; cut off a map-edge surface island (TouchesEdge); stop the absolute-rule BFS at walls.
finding:REACH_VETO_FIX_ONE_END_ENOUGH.text: RM_PocketGridMath.ReachVetoed vetoes only when BOTH ends lack a way, so a laddered pocket is approved into a sealed pocket (A* refuses, jobs loop on PatherFailed). CanReachMapEdge is not vetoed for a surface island ringed by an unclimbable trench. Absolute-rule trap BFS walks through walls.

finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.accept: none, no acceptance filed; the note says run selftest_flowworks_stock.py and close if green.
finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.proposed_fix: Repoint RewireChecks.cs:203 to the DepthSuffix form.
finding:READOUT_CHECK_FIX_STALE_AFTER_PR.text: SelfTest Readout_two_numbers_and_the_limitless_mark fails: RewireChecks.cs:203 expects the old RM_NorthstarProofs line with DepthReadoutAt, which 56bd0e0876 replaced with DepthSuffix; selftest_flowworks_stock.py was red.

finding:READOUT_SELFTEST_MEND_PATTERN_LO.proposed_fix: Repoint the pattern to the DepthSuffix form.
finding:READOUT_SELFTEST_MEND_PATTERN_LO.text: RewireChecks.cs:203 greps RM_NorthstarProofs.cs for a DepthReadoutAt return line that 56bd0e0876 removed (ProofReadout now reads RM_Patch_MouseoverDepth.DepthSuffix), so the selftest is red.

finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.accept: none, no acceptance filed; verify by offline kernel read or sheet selftest.
finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.proposed_fix: Verify by offline kernel read or sheet selftest, then either let the residue dry/flow or document it as intended.
finding:REFUSED_HANDOVER_DRAIN_FIX_PUDDL.text: HandOverTakenCells credits a wet square that became a Receiver/Sink to the engine; whatever the channel refuses (full or a different liquid) stays. On dug/lake cells evaporation and soak are 0 and flow passes skip non-HoldsSheet kinds, so the residue may sit forever (unverified).

finding:REVIEW_MAP_FIX_STATIONS_NO_LEAD_.proposed_fix: Lay out stations to leave room for the straight lead-out. For 35/36, find whether the builder reads the wrong label (HARNESS) or the ladder never reaches up (MOD).

finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.accept: Held gate reads open=True in the stage's own log; stage fits or refuses with a reason on small maps.
finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.claim: owner_review_stage reads a held gate state from the whole hold-open report (held_open_suffix, open=True); a gate that did not open is captioned hold-open tried with a note, never HELD OPEN. 4932169665 + 8e48f09407.
finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.proposed_fix: Read map size and fit layout or refuse before staging; read door state after gate_open and print the full report; arm the shooter or say the row cannot be.
finding:REVIEW_STAGE_FIX_SMALL_MAPS_HELD.text: owner_review_stage places bars_* rows off-map on a 250 map (site at origin+150) without checking map size; held-open gates read open=False after water_scenes_walk.gate_open; the bars_trench shooter has no ranged weapon.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ADAPT_SUITE_SCENES_T.proposed_fix: Build scene_empty_game.suite_vacuous(suite): run each live chain on a modcheck.TestContext over an empty session (bare-success calls, empty things_at, no-op ticks), list PASS components; use it in judge_certificate._asks_on_empty_game, loading validation.py in its own bounded process.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ADAPT_SUITE_SCENES_T.text: The certificate's asks_on_empty_game clause ran in-game scenes on an empty game only for FlowWorks' concept_scenes.py. Every other mod's modcheck Suite chains (validation.py) read 'did not run: no empty-game adapter'.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.accept: would_pass: the delay in days survives a pulse-slider change.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.proposed_fix: Store the delay in ticks or days; derive pulses at use.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_ANCHOR_CROP_DROWN_DE.text: cropDrownPulses ships 1680 (7 days at the 250-tick pulse) but is stored in pulses, so moving the pulse slider (60..2500) silently changes the crop-drown delay to 1.68..70 days.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_COAT.text: No coating condition exists after wading oil, so scene_coating_wash FAILs and COAT_water_washes_it passed vacuously with no coat on the pawn.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_THRE.text: FlowWorks certificate read three offline deciders red with no item owing them: T_FETCH_FALLEN_OFFLINE, T_LIQUID_COATING_OFFLINE, T_TOSS_FLAME_OFFLINE. Fetch-fallen feature was missing; the other two were stale results.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BUILD_FLOWWORKS_TOSS.text: The 'toss a flame' order does not exist: sc_toss_flame fails with 'Unknown JobDef RM_TossFlame', and TOSS_picked_square_lights_first and TOSS_control_water_twin_stays_dark FAIL.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.accept: proof_all --live --only scenes, tier gimmesomeslack_flowworks: SC_under_liquid_pit passes (2 m water: no cord on water, dives at banks with 2 stubs).
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.proposed_fix: Let GSS dive under swim-depth def-Standable water via a terrain tag or DefModExtension FlowWorks puts on its swim-depth terrains, read by name; decide dug-depth cells. Add a Superdeep matrix scene.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_BURY_GSS_CORDS_IN_FW.text: GSS lays one cord on the surface of FlowWorks' RM_Fill_Water_Superdeep instead of diving. SnapshotBlock.Of buries only Impassable water, and Superdeep inherits WaterShallow (Standable, WaterproofConduitable).

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.accept: Live: live-proof A1 of RIMMANDRAKE_PROVE_FLOWWORKS_TOGGLES_DENSE reads shooting_rule_off and shooting_rule_on_pit_only PASS, or the row is rewritten and a mutant fails it. Offline: none.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.proposed_fix: Read vanilla AttackTargetFinder for the scene's verb and range, then fix the mod or rewrite the row to vanilla's real rule with a mutant (rule forced on) that fails it.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CHECK_SHOOTING_RULE_.text: With the superdeep shooting rule OFF, the shooter picked 11098 instead of the nearer pit enemy Human11094. It is not known whether the mod fails to restore vanilla targeting or the row's nearest-target expectation is wrong. shooting_rule_on_pit_only read UNMEASURED.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_CORRECT_SPRINKLER_RA.proposed_fix: Text only: change the label and kernel comment to say 25.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DECIDE_SIXTH_WATER_S.text: pondHeadRuleEnabled ('Connected water levels to one surface') feeds nothing since the exact-level kernel; its only reader, the kernel adapter, went with the whole-notch engine (11977bc06f). Its menu text 'Off: a pond feeds any ditch until it is empty' is false.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DELETE_FILL_N_ONE_WA.accept: none, no acceptance command filed; guard selftest_flowworks_one_water_number.py was red on base (14) and green after chunk 1. Live checks fw_slime_slip_exact.py and fw_one_water_grid_exact.py named.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DELETE_FILL_N_ONE_WA.proposed_fix: Store and speak water only as exact dL/metres: delete fill N (fillGrid+partGrid -> one int[] dL grid), the levelExact switch and setFill=N; wet = above 5 cm; surfaces cut smoothly at true level; test scenes set water per body. Pit depth stays 0.5 m notches.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DELETE_FILL_N_ONE_WA.text: Water is stored in two forms: a whole-notch fill grid plus a part grid, with a whole-notch 'Water stands exactly level' switch and setFill=N. Notch rounding makes waterlines, wet checks and slime chance disagree with the exact dL water the engine runs.

finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DESIGN_FLOWWORKS_DIG.proposed_fix: Design one consolidated interface for dig, repair, fill in and the rest, with dig speed tuning inside it; input is design/specs/2026-11-13-flowworks-dig-interface-census.md. Divergent work for FlowWorks 0.2.0.
finding:RIMMANDRAKE_DESIGN_FLOWWORKS_DIG.text: The FlowWorks dig UI is a daunting grid of options (5 Orders designators, 40-entry 'Dig to depth' float menu, 11 Structure designators, 33 buildables); the depth menu's digger-days estimate omits the x4 labour multiplier; digging is slow. Design one consolidated UI.

trap:a-lidded-trench-is-one-deck-a-lone-.text: A lidded trench is one deck: a lone raider walks over it and every lid stays; two on it at once and every lid gives way. A trench across the path made two-at-once chance (9 raiders, 200 polls, nobody fell). Stage the pit along the path (the passage).
